scenes.title: Total interest on a $30,000 loan at 7%
scenes.say: Borrow thirty thousand at a hypothetical seven percent. Over four years, interest is about forty five hundred.

scenes.label: extra interest for the lower monthly payment
scenes.say: Stretch it to six years and you pay about twenty three hundred more.

scenes.title: Look at the total, not the monthly.
scenes.say: Look at the total, not the monthly. Follow for more money math.
